artworks.title: Relaxing Soldier
artworks.medium: graphite with pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man reclining on a surface. He is leaning back on his right arm with his left arm on his thigh. His legs are extended forward, with his right leg slightly bent. The man has European features, short dark hair, and a mustache. He wears a uniform with a double-breasted jacket and trousers, suggesting a military or formal style. Next to him is a rectangular object with text including "5th Battalion" and "3 B. F.F.I.E." The background is plain.

artworks.title: Study for "The House that Jeff Built"
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1952)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing a group of people depicted in full body. The people are standing in an informal cluster, with minimal facial details and varying head coverings. The clothing is depicted in a loose style, with men in long coats and hats and one woman in a long dress and bonnet. The background suggests an outdoor market or gathering space, with a tent or booth structure in the center. Some individuals appear to be holding flat, rectangular items.

artworks.title: Grim Spain
artworks.medium: etching with plate tone on buff wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a path or road moving diagonally across the scene towards a series of buildings on the left. On the right, a distant cityscape with rooftops and vertical structures is visible beyond the path and buildings. The horizon line is relatively high in the image, just above the distant city structures. The artist's technique involves detailed, linear strokes creating a textured appearance on the structures and sky. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black for a sepia-tone image. The path appears sandy and slightly uneven, leading towards the buildings. The sky features delicate line work suggesting clouds and atmospheric conditions.

artworks.title: Craibe Angus
artworks.medium: drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of an elderly man's upper body in profile view, facing right. The man's head is slightly bent downwards, and he has distinctive facial features including a prominent nose and a bushy beard blending into his neck. His short, textured hair appears thick. The man is wearing an undefined garment, possibly a robe. The background is plain, emphasizing the etching's lines and texture with no additional elements.

artworks.title: Cactus from Mexico
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum exchange, 1960)
artworks.description: Two men are depicted standing in front of a large agave plant. The man on the left is holding a cigar close to his mouth with his left hand. He has a mustache, dark, bushy eyebrows, and is wearing a bowler hat, long coat, pants, and shoes. The man on the right has his right hand on his hip and his left hand extended, pointing at the cigar of the first man. He wears a hat with a wide brim, a scarf, long-sleeve shirt, pants, and shoes. In the background, a large agave plant dominates the scene, with a building faintly visible in the distance. Birds are drawn in the sky.

artworks.title: Two Peasants
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1964)
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of two individuals captured from head to toe. The woman on the left is depicted walking, with her body slightly turned towards the viewer. Her facial features are drawn, showing a serene expression with a gentle smile, and her hair is partially covered by a scarf or headwrap. She is wearing a long flowing dress with a fabric draped around her shoulders, and her right hand is holding the edge of the dress near her thigh, while her left hand holds a stick or rope. The man next to her appears to be in a relaxed walking position, looking slightly downward. His facial features are drawn with a focused and attentive expression, and he wears a hat. He is dressed in a loose-fitting shirt, jacket, and trousers. He holds a similar stick or rope in his hands. The piece has a simple and neutral background, featuring the artist's signature in the bottom right corner, and a small crescent shape drawn towards the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Fireplace in the Gatehouse, Kennelworth, Warwickshire
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Mrs. Benjamin Ogle Tayloe, 1879)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene. The room has ornate wood paneling, a central fireplace with antlers above it, and words inscribed on the mantel. Armor and weaponry are displayed on the walls and floor. There is a stained-glass window with drapery, a table with a green tablecloth, and richly decorated chairs. The scene gives an impression of domestic life from the 17th century.

artworks.title: Political Cartoon of the American Civil War
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on blue-gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in three-quarter length. The figure on the right is seated and turned to the left, looking at the other figure. This person has a crown-like headdress, wavy, shoulder-length hair, and draped clothing resembling ancient garments. They hold a framed object and lean on a backless seat. The person on the left is standing, gesturing with raised right arm and bent left arm. They wear a helmet with a plume, curly hair, and utilitarian attire with scalloped edges. In front of them are a shield or circular object and a staff or rod. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Man in Cap and Coat
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting a man standing in a pose with one leg slightly bent. He is wearing a long coat, a cap with a short brim, fitted pants, and simple shoes. The background is plain with a few faint horizontal lines, and the date "May 21st, 1852" is written near the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Tiger
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a painting of a solitary animal walking across a barren landscape. The creature appears to be a large feline. The background is a broad expanse of blended browns and muted colors, with the horizon gently separating the earth from the sky. The palette gives a contemplative feel to the scene, highlighting the animal as the central subject of the artwork. This is in the style of Antoine-Louis Barye.

artworks.title: Probité chinoise
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men seated in a line along a table, with one man standing and leaning over the table, facing the others. The standing man has a bald head with a small topknot, wearing a patterned garment. Some seated men wear different styles of hats, robes, and tunics. The men have exaggerated facial expressions and seem to be listening intently to the standing man. The background displays intricate patterns.

artworks.title: The Bud and the Blossom [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1965)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing the upper half of two figures - a woman and a child. Both are facing left in side profile. The woman has long, curly hair and delicate facial features with a soft expression. She wears a gown with puffed sleeves and a cinched waist. The child also has curly hair framing their face and wears attire with puffed sleeves. They appear to be leaning affectionately against the woman. The sketch is framed within a simple line border, with a plain background. The surrounding space shows signs of aging, and there is some faded handwritten text at the bottom of the drawing.

artworks.title: Study for "Faith" and "Hope"
artworks.medium: transparent and opaque watercolor over graphite on illustration board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of James Parmelee, 1941)
artworks.description: The image features two full-length figures depicted in a watercolor style. The person on the left is standing with one arm raised, looking upward, with light brown hair framing a face that is slightly turned. They are dressed in a flowing garment with a green robe underneath and a rose or pink cloak over it, draped down their arm. The figure beside them, on the right, has their head slightly bowed with one hand on their chest. This person has long hair and their face is partly obscured by a hooded cloak that is light blue with a green lining. The clothing of both figures appears to be loose and flowing. The background is a blend of dark colors with a hint of cloudy or ethereal form in soft blues and purples.

artworks.title: Female Torso
artworks.medium: graphite with watercolor on laid paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1950)
artworks.description: The image shows a partial depiction of a person's body, focusing mainly on the upper half. The person is in a side profile, with one arm partially extended to the side. The facial features are sketched delicately, with shadows hinting at the contours of the face, and short hair drawn with simple lines. The clothing appears loose around the lower body, with no visible jewelry or objects. The person is against a plain background.

artworks.title: Study for "Commerce"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on wove paper mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: The image features three separate panels of detailed pencil drawings, each depicting multiple figures in various poses and settings. In the left panel, a group of individuals, mainly women, are shown in dynamic positions; one is seated while the others stand, with a prominent figure holding a large basket above their head. A winged horse is in the background. The middle panel features a central seated figure with a staff, flanked by others who are standing or seated around them, potentially on a boat as three figures are rowing with oars. The right panel contains two central figures draped in flowing garments; one of them appears to have a large, circular object behind their head reminiscent of a halo. Below them are cherub-like figures, some of which are in water, with visible wings. The background includes detailed architectural and nature elements like columns, fabric drapes, and foliage.

artworks.title: Entrez donc dans la mer sans crainte ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures positioned at the edge of the water, facing each other. The person on the left is standing with one foot in the water and their body slightly turned towards the other figure. They have a thin face with a pronounced nose and are wearing a checkered swimsuit and a bathing cap. The person on the right is partially submerged, standing in the water up to their knees, with a slightly hunched posture. They have a worried facial expression, short hair, and are also wearing a bathing cap and a plaid swimsuit. Neither of the figures is holding any objects. The background features a simple water scene with soft waves, and the horizon is visible in the distance with faint birds drawn in the sky. The illustration has an overall sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Solitude
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded area with tall, slender trees in a cluster. The trees are vertical, bending slightly in one direction. The horizon is visible behind the trees, with more vegetation extending to the edge. The artwork features detailed textures of tree barks and foliage, with subtle shading around the roots. The color palette is mainly sepia and brown, giving a vintage and natural impression. In the distance, dense trees create a dark mass, enhancing the depth of the scene.

artworks.title: Camp Ellsworth, Near Alexandria—Five Zouaves
artworks.medium: graphite and gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a camp scene with several tents and soldiers engaged in various activities. The drawing depicts a forest setting with a cluster of tents in the background, and a group of soldiers gathered around in the foreground. Some soldiers are conversing or attending to tasks, while one is sitting and another is standing nearby. The shading and white highlights add depth to the figures and foliage. The scene provides a glimpse into camp life.

artworks.title: Eighteenth-Century Colonist Preaching to Indians
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: The image shows an ink drawing of a scene in a wooded area. In the center of the composition, a group of people is gathered in a forest setting. Trees arch overhead, creating a partial canopy with their outlines and shading. The horizon line is not clearly visible, but the eye is drawn upwards towards a standing figure among the trees in the background. The drawing features intricate line work to define the figures and natural elements, conveying texture and depth. The color palette consists of varying shades of brown ink on toned paper to create contrast. The people are arranged in a circular formation on the ground, appearing engaged in a communal activity. The forest setting is depicted with cross-hatching and line work to convey its dense and organic nature.

artworks.title: Study of Courtesans
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures in a classical setting. The scene shows individuals within an architectural structure reminiscent of classical or medieval architecture, complete with arches and columns. The figures are engaged in an act of giving or receiving, with one figure seated on the ground, accompanied by a child. Another figure is kneeling, holding an object that appears to be a helmet or container. The attire of the figures is detailed, with flowing robes, armored elements, and ornate patterns. The background features architectural details and statues. The drawing conveys a narrative, rich in period details and settings.

artworks.title: St. Peter's Church
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate church window. The artwork depicts an intricately designed Gothic-style arched window of a church, framed by a stone structure with elaborate carvings. The stained glass sections are detailed with repeating patterns, and a subtle play of light and shadow suggests an overhanging foliage partially sketched above the window frame. The caption "St. Peter's Church" is lightly sketched beneath the architectural detail. The drawing uses soft colors and delicate lines to emphasize the craftsmanship of the window and stonework.

artworks.title: Profile of a Man
artworks.medium: graphite on the reverse of a hotel menu
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a man's profile, depicting his head and shoulders. The man is facing left, with a straight nose, slightly full lips, a pronounced jawline with sideburns, and glasses low on his nose. His hair has a receding hairline with curls at the top. He is wearing a collared garment, possibly a jacket over a high-collared shirt. The background shows faint handwritten notes and numbers on the sheet around the sketch. There are no additional objects in the image.

artworks.title: Two Cavaliers [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two individuals from head to toe. The person on the left appears to have long curly hair and a neutral facial expression, wearing elaborate, period-appropriate clothing. The person on the right stands close by, wearing a wide-brimmed hat that shadows their face slightly and similar period attire. Both individuals are surrounded by loosely drawn sketches of possible figures and architectural elements, giving the image a dreamy atmosphere. One person appears to be holding a flute or similar object. The background is minimally detailed with light sketches of additional figures and objects.

artworks.title: Reclining Woman
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman seated with one leg crossed over the other. Her upper body is slightly leaning back against a cushioned surface. She has a calm expression and direct gaze, long straight hair, and wears a long, flowing garment with fitted sleeves and a belt around her waist. The woman is barefoot and rests on a patterned textile near a basket. Faint outlines of foliage are in the background.
